evals.prompt: Create a self-contained HTML page that compares an inline Mermaid diagram with a separate-pane layout, then show it to me on my Mac. I am connected to this headless machine remotely and do not want to manage a preview server or port.
evals.expected_output: Creates the HTML in a private runtime directory, opens it with ropen, avoids project-local preview state and new servers, and requests feedback in chat.
assertions: Uses ropen as the preview transport
Keeps preview state outside the repository in a private runtime directory
Does not start or propose a localhost preview server
Uses self-contained content and requests feedback in chat

evals.prompt: Update the browser mockup you showed me so the recommended option uses a blue border. Refresh the same preview rather than giving me a new URL.
evals.expected_output: Updates the existing artifact path and invokes ropen on that same path so the current browser tab refreshes.
assertions: Updates the existing artifact rather than creating a new preview URL
Invokes ropen on the same absolute path to refresh the tab
Does not start another server or alter networking

evals.prompt: Show me this generated HTML report in my browser, but ropen is not installed in this environment.
evals.expected_output: Reports the missing ropen precondition and does not start a localhost server, expose a port, or silently choose another transport.
assertions: Does not start a localhost server or expose a port
Does not silently choose another transport
Leaves the artifact local pending a user decision
